# Firebase JS SDK (vendored)

Unmodified browser builds of `firebase-app.js`, `firebase-auth.js` and `firebase-firestore.js`
from the `firebase` npm package, version 12.19.0 (the same files served at
`https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.19.0/`). Only two edits: the import of `firebase-app.js`
points at the local copy, and the source-map comment is removed.

Served from this site so sign-in and sync work offline and don't depend on a CDN.
